_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. Secrets never belong in this file: the mailbox password and any API secret live in the encrypted store (data/secrets.bin), set with `omni-ingest secrets set mail.password` or from the admin panel.

security._comment: Client networks that may use the MCR panel without signing in. An empty list means everyone signs in. Set this to the newsroom subnet, e.g. ["10.20.0.0/16"]. Replaces the removed `auth_mode`, which opened the panel to every host that could reach the port.

tls._comment: Path to a PKCS#12 (.pfx) certificate holding the certificate and its private key -- the form Windows IT issues. Set the passphrase with `omni-ingest secrets set web.tls_password`. When set, the panels are served over HTTPS and the session cookie gains Secure. Default is plain HTTP on the LAN.
